_readme: Google Scholar (or other) profile links for the people credited on the
research page — the 'Data:' and 'Analysis:' lines under each slide.
Paste a URL beside a name and that name becomes a link on the research
page. Leave it as "" and the name renders as plain text, exactly as it
does today. Nothing here is required.
Names must match the front matter in content/<card>/<n>.md character for
character. build.py adds any new credit name here automatically with an
empty URL, so this list stays in step with the slides on its own — you
only ever fill in the right-hand side.
A comma-separated credit ('data: "Jane Doe, John Roe"') is split on the
commas and each name is looked up on its own.
Any URL works, not just Scholar — a lab page or company site is fine for
a name that is not a person.
